scope: R2 profit factor all-zero denominator precedence only; every R1/R3/R4 path, input, parameter and gate stays unchanged.

evaluation_order: If the sum of negative completed-trade losses is zero, return null, including no trades and all-zero PnL.
Otherwise return the sum of positive completed-trade PnL divided by the absolute sum of losses; zero positive PnL therefore returns 0.
